# Bionic Computer — Total IT Solutions & Computer Support in Karachi

> Bionic Computer is a premier IT consulting, hardware repair, networking, cybersecurity, and managed IT services provider headquartered in Karachi, Pakistan. Incorporated in 1999, our tagline is "We Care Your System".

## Core Services
- **Computer Hardware & Repair**: Sales, upgrades, component replacement, diagnostics, laptop & desktop repairs, printer maintenance, UPS, and stabilizer support.
- **Networking & Structured Cabling**: Secure LAN/WAN design, router/switch configuration, Cat6 structured cabling, and enterprise fiber setup.
- **Cybersecurity & Data Protection**: Security audits, firewall installation, anti-malware, cloud backup, and risk reduction.
- **Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC)**: Preventive maintenance, scheduled checkups, 24/7 priority emergency IT support contracts.
- **Cloud & Server Management**: Windows Server & Linux administration, virtualization, active directory, and cloud migration.
- **Software & Web Development**: Custom business applications, responsive corporate websites, and portal development.
